reviews.title: Not Upfront and Hard to Switch Carriers
reviews.text: When I switched to Mint Mobile, it was very affordable. They advertised $15 a month, but they aren’t upfront about terms and conditions. You only pay $15 for three months, but you have to pay the full $45 upfront, and then pay $45 a month. It is considered affordable due to the monthly rate at $45, but you can only pay for your plan in semi annual increments, allowing no monthly plan. That’s $130 out of my pocket including taxes. I don’t like the dishonesty, so I wanted to switch over to something more affordable. Today, I spent hours trying to switch to a different carrier from Mint Mobile. It was an extremely frustrating process, as Mint Mobile only does verification through SMS, and I had to sit over chat for 2 hours just to get my account number and transfer pin. It took me an hour to switch over to my new carrier because of issues through Mint Mobile not correctly transferring my information

reviews.title: Terrible customer “whatever”. I wouldn’t call it Support or Service
reviews.text:
Took almost 3 weeks to get an unlocked new iPhone 17 activated with an eSIM as an existing customer of 3 years who rarely uses a gig or 2 of the 6 GB data plan that doesn’t rollover. Once activated, I chose the option to transfer nothing, just login to my Apple account. 

Mint KNOWS that I just activated my new iPhone 17 and gave no warning or grace period. All 6 GB of my data plan was gone in one (1!!!) day! 

I’m stuck in the hospital and this roadside stand of a mobile phone data (Provider? Company? Lemonade stand?) is a joke. But I guess they do advertise that they are a big joke. 

Now I can either pay their ransom for an extra month or more for “extra” data, or my phone stays unusable until more data renews… in 1 month.

reviews.title: Horrible Customer Service
reviews.text: I want to start by saying this is NOT directed at any of the employees I talked to, they were great and very apologetic, and also agreed that the general systems in place were inconvenient and absurd. It seems there was an issue with my payment and with no warning Mint shut off my service and suspended my account. I can’t get on the app to fix the payment info, because you have to do text verification to open the app, and they shut off my service. I go into the help chat to see if they can open my account, and they said the only way to fix it would be to call their help line. Call the help line, with no phone service. So I am unable to get phone service back on unless I have access to phone service? It just makes no sense, it took hours to fix an issue that literally could have been as easy as me hoping on the app and updating my info, and I see NO reason the app couldn’t also offer email verification to help with this. ALSO, in the hours of trying to get it fixed I tried just purchased a new plan in hopes I could just turn that on instead, but nope! Instead, Mint allowed me to purchase a new plan, with all of the same details as my old account (name, email, PHONE NUMBER) and never once flag to me that I wouldn’t be able to use it under that account, until I tried to activate it.

reviews.title: 6 months of struggle to unlock my phone and 10 days without service
reviews.text: I purchased my phone paid-in-full directly from Mint Mobile over a year ago. Per their policy, the device should have been unlocked automatically long ago. Instead, I have been forced to deal with an unresolved carrier lock that has left me completely without cellular service for 10 days. As a remote worker, this extended outage is incredibly disruptive because I rely entirely on my phone to do my job. Front-line customer service has been completely unhelpful throughout this entire process. Instead of escalating the technical issue to someone who can actually unlock the hardware, they had the audacity to offer me a trivial $10 discount to stay with the service. The service coverage was fine but far from great in my area to begin with, but this total failure in customer support and policy enforcement is unacceptable. If you rely on your phone for your livelihood, be aware that you may be left stranded if you experience a technical issue with your hardware. Whoever is monitoring this page will probably reply with a generic script apologizing, stating "this is not the experience we want for you," and directing me to call their support team. But, in reality, they will not do anything to help you. Following those directions is simply wasting your time, and a lot of it, for absolutely nothing. And if you think the problem can be resolved by changing the phone number, nope! The device itself was completely locked and limited to Mint Mobile. So if you're looking to buy a new device,

reviews.title: Had Mint for Several Years Now
reviews.text: I’ve had Mint Mobile service for years now. The service has always been very bad when out & about, but I’m a recluse that stays home on my WiFi, so the cheap service has been fine. Recently they made some changes & now every time I open the app to check my family’s data usage or make payments it doesn’t recognize my phone & makes me jump through hoops to prove I’m me to access my info! I’ve had this Mint service on the same phone & SIM for years. I’ve contacted support several times & they always tell me something different & it’s always nonsense. The last guy said the app wouldn’t recognize a user if you logged in on WiFi & can only open the app in Mobile mode. What is that ridiculousness?? The service is so bad, I’d rarely be able to access it & at my rural residence, there is ZERO mobile service, so this company now says paying consumers of their service cannot access their app, which is the only way I get data or payment information! Also, do be aware that if you pay annually, you cannot get a refund after the initial 7 days after payment, even if months in they break their app & restrict access to your essential information.

reviews.title: DO NOT BUY MINT MOBILE
reviews.text:
I have been on the phone with Mint Mobile for over 4 hours and it was an absolute nightmare. The customer service was extremely unprofessional, unclear, and unhelpful. Most of the representatives could barely communicate properly, gave conflicting information, and did not seem to understand the issue at all.

They kept hanging up, transferring me endlessly, and somehow managed to switch my two phone lines and phone numbers, creating an even bigger mess than what I originally called for. Instead of fixing anything, they made everything worse and showed zero urgency or accountability.

This was the biggest waste of time I’ve experienced with any company. I would never recommend Mint Mobile to anyone. If I could give 0 stars, I absolutely would. Save yourself the frustration and do not buy from them. the entire experience felt sketchy. The representatives sounded like scammers trying to take your money, not a legitimate phone company. Nothing was clear, answers kept changing, and instead of helping, they just wasted time and caused more problems. It was beyond frustrating and completely unprofessional.

reviews.title: eSIM transfer failure + impossible support = lost number for 30 days
reviews.text:
I had a serious issue caused by the Mint Mobile app and customer support, and it completely broke access to my phone number.

I attempted to transfer my eSIM from one phone to another using the Mint app. The app failed during the process, and I immediately lost access to my eSIM and phone number. From that point on, everything went downhill.

When trying to recover my account, I discovered there was a one-letter typo in my email address (made during setup). The system does not allow correcting this, which made verification impossible. Despite this being a common and easily fixable issue, support provided no real recovery path.

I was escalated to backend support twice. Each time, I was asked to answer verification questions that I simply cannot answer (old device data, exact timestamps, etc.). There was no alternative verification method offered, no human judgment, and no flexibility.

The final outcome: my phone number is locked for 30 days, despite the issue being triggered by an app failure and a rigid support process.

This is unacceptable for a mobile carrier. Losing access to your number for a month because of an app bug and unhelpful support is not something customers should risk.

Mint is cheap, but when something goes wrong, you are completely on your own. If this is a critical number for work or personal life, think twice before relying on this service.

reviews.title: Completely useless
reviews.text: Mint sent a text that my payment method was declined so I went to their website to change cards. Simple right? No! They also decided to lock my account so there was no way of changing my card. Then couldn’t call the credit card company to figure out why my payment was declined despite abundant funds and recent (correct) payment. After calling to change it the robot told me that it was on autopay and just wait. So it won’t let me make a payment online because they locked my account and I can’t call to make a payment because it’s on auto pay. I strongly implore you to choose any competitor, I’d pay twice as much for half the services at this point. There is absolutely no way that any of those positive reviews are real. They probably spend more on bot farms protecting their ranking than they would if they just provided a FUNCTIONING webpage. If I have to call customer service to get my account number after a good ten minutes of searching your site then you should fire whatever moron thought that hiding our account numbers would stop us from switching.
